newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to speak on radio about 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to speak on radio about 1997 budget.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin will give a radio address later this week in which he will outline his views on the 1997 budget, the presidential press service said on Wednesday.

Yeltsin signed the budget into law on Tuesday after it cleared its final parliamentary hurdle in the upper chamber Federation Council on February 12. It was approved by the lower house State Duma last month after months of wrangling.
The budget sets a deficit of 3.5 percent of gross domestic product according to Russian calculations on revenues of 434 trillion roubles and spending of 529.8 trillion roubles.
